UPDATE role_skill_requirements
                    SET min_proficiency = $2, importance = $3, note = COALESCE(note, $4),
                        source_level = CASE WHEN $5 THEN $6 ELSE source_level END,
                        source_scale_max = CASE WHEN $5 THEN $7 ELSE source_scale_max END
                  WHERE id = $1
